eyebrow: ISNULL: exactly two arguments, nested for more
code:
-- ISNULL caps at two arguments -- nest it for a third:
SELECT ISNULL(pp.PhoneNumber,
         ISNULL(ea.EmailAddress, 'No contact on file')) AS BestContact
FROM Person.Person AS p
LEFT JOIN Person.PersonPhone AS pp
  ON pp.BusinessEntityID = p.BusinessEntityID
LEFT JOIN Person.EmailAddress AS ea
  ON ea.BusinessEntityID = p.BusinessEntityID;
caption: COALESCE does the same job flat, in one call, with no nesting.
ISNULL's type comes from the FIRST argument, no matter what.

code:
-- COALESCE follows data type precedence across ALL arguments:
SELECT COALESCE(@ShortCode,
  'This is a much longer fallback string') AS CoalesceResult;
-- Result: 'This is a much longer fallback string'
caption: No silent truncation — the result type is wide enough to fit.
